author: Jeremy3463
quote: GTA 6 looks really good graphically, and I can imagine that once the PC version is released, the visuals will be even more impressive, thanks to the capabilities of dedicated graphics cards. That said, I have to say that the game is fundamentally disappointing. We waited so long, it was even delayed only for it to be released in a buggy state. I can’t put into words how sad that makes me. The story is excellent, I have no complaints there. While it’s perfectly normal for a game to have some bugs, it’s not right that GTA gets such a pass, especially when other games have been harshly criticized at launch for having similar issues. I hold every game to the same standard, and therefore, I have to say that the sheer number of bugs here is a major problem. Otherwise, the gameplay doesn’t differ significantly from previous GTA games which is fine, though I would have liked to see some change that made this game truly unique. The ability to take on relationships doesn’t count, you’re better off finding a relationship in real life!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I already really loved the base game. It’s beautiful, and the levels are simply fantastic. The DLC and the Switch 2 version make the whole experience even better. The new challenges introduced by the DLC are great!
game_title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World

author: Jeremy3463
quote: The concept of a semi-"open world" on the world map is very well executed. Adding enemies as friendly NPCs who fight alongside you and help you complete levels is a great touch.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: The remake of the Wii game has turned out well. The art style is lovely, even if it isn’t to everyone’s taste. The levels are well-designed. The new challenges are excellent, as are the minigames and Theme Park.
game_title: Kirby's Return to Dream Land Deluxe

author: Jeremy3463
quote: An absolute classic when it comes to Kirby. The idea of ​​using different Kirbys to get through the levels is truly brilliant. I loved it as a child.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Great DLC for the original game. The new levels in the bonus episode are excellent and a lot of fun!
game_title: Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker - Special Episode

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I really can’t say anything bad about this. The small 3D worlds are truly beautiful! The hidden locations of the jewels and the number of episodes are really great.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Great story mode. I enjoyed it just as much as the first installment. The bosses were really creative and tricky.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: A truly great expansion to the story mode, with a style all its own. The levels are very specific, and I like the overall presentation.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I wasn’t really a fan of the online mode in Splatoon, BUT the story mode was absolutely fantastic. The levels were great, and collecting the scrolls taught you a lot about the story.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Minecraft Dungeons is a truly great spin-off. The base game is substantial enough, and the DLCs add many new missions and pieces of equipment. The pricing for the DLCs is also reasonable.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I mean, Minecraft Legends is alright. I do understand, however, why it’s so unpopular among players. I generally enjoyed it, but it became repetitive after a while.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Story Mode was, by far, one of the best Minecraft spin-offs ever. It’s a shame that it’s become so difficult to get hold of these days. My love for the game remains to this day the interactive gameplay style is simply creative!
game_title: Minecraft: Story Mode - A Telltale Games Series

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I still remember Minecraft Earth well. It came out back in the days of Pokémon GO, and I played it. Placing Minecraft characters and blocks into the real world was actually pretty cool. It’s a shame it was discontinued.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Story Mode was, by far, one of the best Minecraft spin-offs ever. It’s a shame that it’s become so difficult to get hold of these days. My love for the game remains to this day the interactive gameplay style is simply creative!
game_title: Minecraft: Story Mode - Season Two: The Telltale Series

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Dungeons 2 is really a lot of fun. The new areas are great, and the general adjustments to the inventory/equipment system are truly excellent.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: The good old classic. I don’t think I need to say anything about this, other than that it’s great.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I just love everything about this. For me, it’s the best Pikmin game, as it combines almost everything from the previous entries—caves, Pikmin, and enemies. The areas are really beautifully crafted, and the night expeditions are great, too.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: This remake is truly beautiful. I enjoyed every minute of the game and think it’s a really well-executed Zelda title. It’s been crafted with such obvious love!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Mario & Luigi: Brothership is in a league of its own. The visuals are lovely, and the various islands are creative. The bosses offer a good challenge, and the missions from NPCs really bring the game to life.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I have to say, it’s genuinely challenging. I’ve already played through NSLU to 100% three times, and I still died quite a few times. In multiplayer, it’s sometimes easier, but in other places, it’s actually tougher. A good "little" DLC.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: By far my favorite Mario Party. Even though it’s old, the boards and minigames were truly creative! I still love it to this day.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Rest in peace, Mario Kart Tour. I didn’t play it much, but at the time of its release, it was a real hit in the mobile scene. The controls were super easy.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Many people don’t like it, but the free-roam driving alone, along with the variety of characters and tracks, is absolutely top-notch.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: A Super Mario and Luigi game. The remake really improved on quite a few things. In terms of graphics alone, the game is much sharper and better designed. The story is great, and it’s honestly addictive, haha!
game_title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story + Bowser Jr.'s Journey

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Following Color Splash and The Origami King, this is a genuinely good Paper Mario game. The hidden areas and levels are well-designed, and some of the puzzles are tricky.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I love this Paper Mario. The visual style is exactly my cup of tea! In terms of gameplay, it’s lovingly crafted, and the card-based combat system is good, too!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I have such fond childhood memories of this Mario Kart. I used to play it all the time with my cousin. The missions are fun and challenging, and the cups are just as enjoyable. Classic Mario Kart!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: This game was my first experience with the franchise, and I have to say it’s solid. It’s not my favorite, but visually it’s really impressive. The worlds are very diverse and genuinely fun.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I’m still actively playing the game to this day. The new updates that arrive every few months always add something fresh. A top-notch mobile game!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I love The Origami King. Visually, it’s just like Sticker Star and Color Splash. In terms of gameplay, it has a lot to offer, and the story is great, too. You’ll need to do plenty of exploring if you want to reach 100% completion. The combat system takes some getting used to, but I actually like it!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: 8 points, the 8th installment in the Mario Kart series. Not much else needs to be said—if you’re a fan of Mario Kart, you’ll love this game too. Multiplayer is recommended for the full experience.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: A great remake of SM64. The controls take some getting used to, but you’ll get the hang of them after a short while. Visually, it serves its purpose well, and in terms of gameplay, it offers a solid amount of content. Increasing the number of stars to 150 is also a fantastic touch. The minigame option feels a bit recycled, but it’s perfectly fine for multiplayer.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Visually, it’s a beautiful remake. In terms of gameplay, it also has quite a lot to offer; however, I have to say that, for me, it was a one-time experience. I wouldn’t play it again.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: For the mobile spin-off of the Super Mario series, it’s genuinely fun. Honestly, the 10 euros for the full version are well worth it. The challenges involved in collecting all the colored coins in each level are great. Building up and expanding your kingdom is also a substantial, long-term undertaking. Super.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: NSMB2 is my second-favorite NSMB game. The visuals, levels, and story are all well-executed.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I have spent countless hours in this game, and it is simply fantastic. Multiplayer with friends is great. Furthermore, as a modder for the game, I still spend countless hours in it to this day.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: NSMBDs is truly my favorite Nintendo DS game. I loved it as a child, and I still do to this day. The minigames are decent, and the little multiplayer Vs. mode is absolutely brilliant!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: NSMBWii is simply a Wii classic. Even though I personally didn't get around to playing it until much later, I have to say that it is a well-executed game. It’s a great choice for multiplayer, though it was eventually superseded by its successor, New Super Mario Bros. U.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: For its age, the game is actually quite okay. The controls take a lot of getting used to, which made it really difficult for me to get into it.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: The 3D All-Stars collection is a great combination of these 3D giants. However, I have to deduct points because it was available in very limited quantities and has since been partially superseded, given that these titles are also playable on the Switch in other ways. That said, I still had fun with it!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Much like 3D World, Super Mario 3D Land is a genuinely good game that I personally found very enjoyable. It features innovative and, at times, quite challenging levels. The only drawback I have to point out is the way the Star Worlds are padded out, as the levels there are frequently recycled.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Super Mario 64 was my first Mario game and my first 3D Mario, too and even as a child, I had the time of my life playing it. I can still play it today and have just as much fun!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: Super Mario 3D World on its own is a classic that is always genuinely fun to play. The addition of Bowser’s Fury makes the whole package even better!

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I really loved Mario Bros. Wonder. The DLC—including the graphical enhancements and the mini-games—is just fantastic. The story expansion featuring the Koopalings is absolutely brilliant. I played it in multiplayer with a friend, and we had a great time!
game_title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I played the original and the 3ds remake and i must say that this remake is absolutly the best choice Nintendo made this year. Ocarina of Time is just amazing, and still made a lot of fun. Really great Game!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I’ve put in seven hours of playtime so far and still haven't finished the game. Sure, the ships repeat occasionally, but they always have different secondary effects. The game's story seems to be extensive.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: A short, relaxing game to play on the side. It’s perfect for anyone who loves letting their creativity run wild while tidying up at the same time.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: It’s a relatively short game to play in between other things. The name says it all -simply chop down trees one by one, buy upgrades and new areas to speed things up. I’ve now completed the game 100% in four hours. 7.5/10.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: A truly successful sequel to The Forest. Graphically, the game has seen a massive improvement, and I definitely enjoyed the gameplay as well. It’s even more fun when playing with friends. With around 40 hours of playtime, there is plenty to do here.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I stumbled upon the game on Steam by chance, bought it immediately, and haven't regretted it. It builds well on puzzles and mechanics, though it has a minor issue where you can easily get lost and not know where to go. Good game.

author: Jeremy3463
quote: I love everything about Splatoon Raiders. Anyone who loved the story mode in the previous games will enjoy this one too. Visually, it is simply beautiful; technically, the game runs smoothly and offers plenty of content, multiplayer features, and a great story. 10/10.
